svg.desc: Should countries agree on a deadline to phase out fossil fuels? Industrial oil storage tank with 20 points. Side A is on the left, side B is on the right. All points are described on the debate page.

g.text: Should countries agree on a deadline to phase out fossil fuels?
A shared date could speed investment. Countries face different costs and energy needs.

svg.text: Piece size follows rank · 1–8 large · 9–13 medium · 14–20 small. Read each full point below.
